across_options.issue: The product photography changes independently of D1. The large jacket photo has different sleeve folds, hem shape, pocket details and floor lighting; the grid jacket and offer thumbnail also change. The sneakers have different lace and panel details, and the lamp and Kindle photographs vary. These are content changes, not state-pill changes, and prevent a controlled comparison (brand/ledger.md Open D1; brand/constitution.md Article 14.4).

Small non-state geometry changes are visible: the offer thumbnail and adjacent text shift, and the black Accept $38 button is slightly wider in B. These layout differences are outside D1 (brand/ledger.md Open D1; brand/constitution.md Article 14.4).
